name: agira
description: Skills for Agira task management: add tasks via the CLI using the agira:add skill; orchestration is handled by the built-in agira runner and bundled sub-agent role definitions

interface.shortDescription: AI-assisted task management for software projects
interface.longDescription: Add tasks to an Agira project using the agira:add skill. Orchestration and execution are handled by the built-in agira runner, which auto-starts on task_added and dispatches work through bundled sub-agent role definitions (enricher, implementer, verifier).
